profile.reading: Per CyrusOne own facility page for Totowa, New Jersey (NYM2), this two-building campus publishes 6 MW of total IT capacity and 200,000 square feet of space, including 50,000 square feet of data center space and 60,000 square feet of work area recovery space, at a street address of 50 Madison Rd Totowa, NJ 07512. CyrusOne describes the site as about 17 miles from Midtown Manhattan and integrated into its National IX connectivity platform.

reading.body:
CyrusOne NYM2 in Totowa publishes 6 MW of IT capacity across 200,000 square feet of technical space. At 10 kW per rack, a common colocation density, 6 MW supports roughly 600 racks; at 40 kW per rack, a density more typical of AI training workloads, the same power budget supports roughly 150 racks. CyrusOne has not published a per-rack power figure for this campus, so neither translation is the operator's claim. Six megawatts is a modest envelope for AI training at scale, though it could serve inference or smaller GPU clusters depending on how the power is distributed within the facility.

The single published certification is SSAE 16 Type II, which attests that an independent auditor has examined and validated the campus's internal controls over a defined period. That qualification is standard for enterprise and regulated-industry tenants. No Tier classification, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or other certification appears in the published specifications.

Among the 47 data center facilities mapped in New Jersey on this site, only two have published a megawatt figure from operator spec pages. NYM2's 6 MW is the second largest of those two, behind a single facility that accounts for the remaining 23 MW of the state's 29 MW published total. NYM2 therefore represents roughly 21 percent of New Jersey's published IT capacity on this site, a share that reflects the scarcity of published figures in the state rather than a complete picture of the state's actual capacity.
